solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Divers' equipment in ship going round island

indicators.note: the ship's letters circle about the island, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: SS is the standard abbreviation for steamship
Cuba is the Caribbean island

explanation.surface: Diving gear stowed aboard a vessel sailing around a tropical island.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-contained underwater breathing apparatus is the kit that divers strap on, so the plural names their equipment.

clue.text: In church tot is behaving badly

indicators.note: the following letters are placed in the abbreviation for church

parts.note: to tot up is to add

explanation.surface: A small child misbehaving during church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tot' looks like a toddler, but it is the verb, as in totting up a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: A cad is an ungentlemanly man, so caddish conduct is dishonourable, ill-mannered behaviour.

clue.text: Cleaner given Birthday Honour — cleaner not half enthralled

indicators.note: the honour holds the other letters captive inside it

parts.note: the BEM, British Empire Medal, is an award in the Birthday Honours list

indicators.note: only half of the word for the cleaner survives, its second half lost

parts.note: soap is a cleaner

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady receives a royal honour, while another cleaner is half spellbound.
explanation.definitionFit: A besom is a broom made of twigs bound to a handle, a sweeping implement.

clue.text: International player, half-hearted reserve at end of season

indicators.note: the reserve piece comes after the season, at its end

parts.note: spring is a season

indicators.note: the word loses half of its heart, one of its two middle letters

parts.note: to book is to reserve

explanation.surface: A national team player makes a lukewarm stand-in at the close of the season.
explanation.definitionFit: The Springboks are South Africa's rugby union side, so a player capped for that country is one.

clue.text: Helpful deed by mouser maybe, catching old rat

parts.note: a good turn is a kind or helpful deed

indicators.note: the mouser grabs the old letter, holding it inside itself

parts.note: a cat is an example of a mouser, hence 'maybe'

explanation.surface: A cat does a good deed by catching an old rat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rat' looks like the cat's prey, but it is the definition, in the sense of a betrayer.
explanation.definitionFit: To rat is to betray one's side, and a rat is a deserter or traitor, which is someone who switches allegiance.

clue.text: Mo starts to pull some muscles

parts.note: a mo, short for moment, is a trice

indicators.note: the starts of the following words are their first letters

explanation.surface: A man called Mo begins to strain a few muscles.
explanation.definitionFit: The muscle at the back of the upper arm has three heads, and its name is used for the muscles there.

clue.text: Comprehends the meaning of loveless nymphs

indicators.note: without love, so the letter for nil in tennis scoring goes

parts.note: Oreads are mountain nymphs in Greek myth

explanation.surface: Someone grasps the significance of nymphs who have no lovers.
explanation.walkthrough: Love is zero in tennis, hence O.
explanation.definitionFit: To read a situation or text is to understand or interpret its meaning.

clue.text: A new chair put out — it's for the dining table

indicators.note: the letters are put out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A new chair is set out by the dining table.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain plates and dishes are crockery laid on a table for meals.

clue.text: Epithet in card wife's left with brief sexist message

indicators.note: the wife has left, so her letter is taken away

parts.note: a card or wag is a joker, a funny person
W is the abbreviation for wife
the short sign 'No men' excludes males

explanation.surface: A nickname appears on a card the wife left with a curt anti-male note.
explanation.definitionFit: In Roman naming, an agnomen was an extra name or nickname added for a deed, like Africanus.

clue.text: 'Changing to sand' is it 'ere?

indicators.note: the letters of the following words are changed around into a new order

parts.note: a dropped-aitch spelling of 'here', taken as written

explanation.surface: A Cockney asks whether the process of land turning to sand is happening right here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Changing' rearranges TO SAND IS IT ERE; the whole clue also describes the process, with 'is it 'ere?' asking where it happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Land turning into desert, such as fertile ground becoming sandy wasteland, is the process called desertification or this variant.

clue.text: Bling that could make you animated

indicators.note: the clue suggests the following word's letters could be reworked to form something else

explanation.surface: Flashy jewellery that might get you excited.
explanation.definitionFit: Bling is showy jewellery, and sparkly fake gems or sequins on clothing are described this way.

clue.text: Introducer of show unconvincing on stage in leather

indicators.note: the introducer of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: hammy acting is overdone and unconvincing

explanation.surface: A show's host performing badly while dressed in leather.
explanation.definitionFit: Chamois leather, a soft cloth for polishing cars and windows, is also spelt this way.

clue.text: Innocent little person has irritating experience meeting revolutionary

parts.note: Che Guevara is the crossword's favourite revolutionary
a rub is a difficulty or source of irritation, as in 'there's the rub'

explanation.surface: A sweet child has an annoying encounter with a radical.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is a chubby angelic child in art, and by extension any sweet innocent youngster.

clue.text: Put down — for example, told to go outside

indicators.note: the word for told goes round the outside of the other letters

parts.note: a story related is one told

explanation.surface: Being demoted, for example by being told to leave the room.
explanation.definitionFit: A team relegated is sent down a division, so moved to a lower position.

clue.text: Carol hugs a businessperson dancing

indicators.note: the carol wraps round the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: to carol is to sing
an MBA is someone with a Master of Business Administration degree

explanation.surface: A woman named Carol embraces a business executive while dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing the Brazilian samba, a lively ballroom dance, is a particular form of dancing.

clue.text: Type getting scolded became less violent

parts.note: a mode is a kind, type or way
to rate someone is an old word for berating or scolding

explanation.surface: A sort who gets told off then calms down.
explanation.definitionFit: When a storm or temper abates it grows milder, losing its extremes.

clue.text: Fur provides covering, type not entirely acceptable

parts.note: to seal something is to close it up or cover it over

indicators.note: the setter's phrase says the word for type is not quite all there, so its final letter is lost

parts.note: a kind is a type or sort

explanation.surface: Fur gives cover, but that sort of thing is not wholly acceptable nowadays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' drops the last letter of KIND to give KIN; 'acceptable' merely completes the surface and the hint at fur's unpopularity.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelt of a fur seal is a classic luxury fur used for coats.

clue.text: Gospel passage in church upset member turning up

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: the nave is the central aisle area of a church

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means reading from the bottom

parts.note: a leg is a limb or member

explanation.surface: A Gospel reading in church upsets a congregation member who arrives.
explanation.definitionFit: An evangel is an archaic term for one of the four New Testament accounts of Christ.

clue.text: Chemical in egg leading to anger

indicators.note: the egg piece comes first, leading into the next

parts.note: a nit is the egg of a louse
to rile is to anger

explanation.surface: A chemical in an egg that provokes fury.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an organic compound with a carbon-nitrogen triple bond, also used for synthetic rubber gloves.

clue.text: Port makes one fade away very quietly with energy minimalised

parts.note: to die away is to fade
pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quietly
energy cut down to its abbreviation, the single letter E used in physics

explanation.surface: A port where one could fade away in silence with little energy left.
explanation.definitionFit: Dieppe is a ferry port on the Normandy coast of France, linked by boat to Newhaven.

clue.text: Item in fancy wrapping dispatched in advance?

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before or in advance
sent means dispatched

explanation.surface: A wrapped gift that was posted early.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark signals the playful split into PRE-SENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift is typically wrapped in decorative paper before it is handed over.

clue.text: Aggressive character to travel with protection of body of guards

indicators.note: travelling under the protection of the guards means sitting inside them

parts.note: a ward is an old term for a company of guards or watchmen
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: A belligerent type travelling under armed escort.
explanation.definitionFit: Mars or Ares is a deity of battle, a mythical figure who embodies aggression.

clue.text: American fool, first person to be taken in by posh female

indicators.note: the first person is taken inside the posh female

parts.note: a deb, debutante, is an upper-class young woman
we is a first-person pronoun

explanation.surface: A posh girl lets a boorish American be the first to fool her.
explanation.definitionFit: Dweeb is US slang for a socially inept or boring person, a nerd.

clue.text: One bringing the end of Caesar, ruddy penetrative?

definitions.text: One bringing the end of Caesar, ruddy penetrative?

indicators.note: the colour word goes into the other letters, penetrating them

parts.note: rust is a reddish-brown colour, so ruddy suggests it

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A conspirator who killed Caesar is pictured stabbing with a reddened dagger.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue pictures Brutus and the other assassins thrusting knives into Caesar.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who drives a blade in, such as an assassin stabbing an emperor, is one who thrusts.

clue.text: Rag at university that sees the night out

parts.note: a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper, such as the Sun, a British tabloid
up means in residence at university, as in 'up at Oxford'

explanation.surface: A student rag week event that lasts all night.
explanation.walkthrough: Rag week is a British student charity fundraising tradition, which the surface evokes.
explanation.definitionFit: Dawn, the moment of daybreak, brings the dark hours to their end.

clue.text: Last Barbarian journalist, one taking position

parts.note: the Goths were Germanic barbarians who sacked Rome
ED, short for editor, is the crossword's usual journalist
I is the Roman numeral one
a stance is a position or posture

explanation.surface: The final barbarian invader is a reporter taking a stand.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going right to the end, as a boxer surviving every round, is to endure, and to last means just that.

clue.text: Cover with black wrapping that can be moved somehow

indicators.note: the black piece is wrapped around the cover

parts.note: sable is the heraldic term for black
a lid is a cover

explanation.surface: A cover with a black wrapper that can be shifted somehow.
explanation.definitionFit: Something capable of gliding along, like a door on runners, is movable in one particular way.

clue.text: Deposit in river leads to charge

indicators.note: the deposit goes inside the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
to deposit something is to put it down

explanation.surface: Depositing something in a river leads to a charge being laid.
explanation.definitionFit: To depute someone is to delegate a task to them, that is, to charge them with it.
